version: D5 matched-acquisition ARF and new-capture extension
purpose: Test whether the frozen GDT integration adds value against a native streaming baseline and on previously unscored captures. Do not optimize for favorable test results.
prior_evidence: D4 confirmation and R6 manuscript results are known. Comparisons added on old DoS15/Bot02 cohorts are retrospective extensions, not new held-out evidence.
capture_choice: Preselected by unused archive membership and distinct attack scenarios, before classifier scoring. Search of prior local experiment scripts found these names only in archive inventory. Both captures must be reported, even if poor or underpowered. Same benchmark/testbed, not independent organizations.
data: Pinned corrected CSE-CICIDS2018 author archive, same 82 predictors and frozen source transforms. Read full selected CSV members, record ZIP CRC and uncompressed SHA256. Remove invalid timestamps, duplicate predictor fingerprints, binary-label conflicts, historical Tuesday2017 overlap, and all previously sampled 2018 cohort fingerprints. Label-blind deterministic 12000-fingerprint samples, sorted by timestamp/raw row. Inspect class support only for eligibility; less than 30 attacks or benign examples makes a capture descriptive, never replace it on model performance. No class-conditional oversampling.
frozen_method: D4 selected hgb_gate_P0_mixed_w2 unchanged. Existing source histories and final S3 retention probes reused without refitting transformations. D4 engine/experiment sources imported read-only and hashes checked.
matched_protocol: Identical per-seed historical BASE source indices, 82 transformed predictors, target stream order, initial historical labels, 5 percent requests (4 training + 1 audit per 100), exact query identities from the frozen HGB/7NN acquisition engine, delayed delivered labels/revisions, whole-block prediction before feedback, and separate audit-only threshold grid/cost/minimum/window. The design isolates detector packages under a shared acquisition policy, not each method's own active-learning policy.
baseline: River 0.22.0 forest.ARFClassifier with published library defaults: 10 trees, sqrt feature subspaces, lambda6 resampling, ADWIN drift/warning defaults, grace50, info_gain, delta0.01, tau0.05, nba leaves, seed matched. Defaults fixed without a new-data hyperparameter search. Native ARF consumes each newly arrived training label once at the next 100-flow boundary; HGB retains its 200-flow replay/refit cadence. ARF learn_one does not support external sample weights (kwargs ignored); use one event per label, explicitly report the weighting/cadence/memory difference. Do not call this identical memory/compute or a pure learner-only causal contrast.
corrections: ARF supports no exact deletion. When a previously learned label changes, restore a deep copy of the initial source-trained ARF and replay all arrived training events once, in first-arrival order, with latest labels. Audit revisions affect threshold only. Issued predictions stay immutable. Record resets, replay work and model drift counts. Retained ledger grows; do not claim bounded-memory equality or production latency.
derivation: GDT, verified-only, and maximum share the exact detector and acquisition state. Derive verified/max routing and each policy's own audit-threshold history from stored per-block model scores; validate against all corresponding original D4 runs. Frozen scores use the initial HGB with threshold0.5 and shared acquisition. Do not count shared fitting as independent evidence or claim multiple training replications.
scenario_definitions: Unchanged D4: delay1 correct; delay80 correct; 10 percent Bernoulli wrong labels corrected400 events after arrival with delay80; evaluator corrupts25 percent true-attack ML2 proposals to0.001 with delay80. ARF itself does not consume ML2 proposals, but shares the resulting acquisition. All labels simulated.
scope: New captures:2x5x4x5=200 system evaluations; 40 shared HGB/NN runs plus40 ARF runs. Old primary captures:2x5x4=40 additional ARF runs; reuse existing GDT/verified/max/frozen traces. Total additional ARF80 and new shared model runs40. Report old and new captures separately, never merge them into an inflated independent-sample count.
metrics: Issued prequential BA, recall, FPR, AP, macroF1, 4FN+FP normalized loss, source BA change, labels requested/arrived, corrections, online update/replay work. Raw ML1/ML2 and gate flips separately. AP from raw/threshold-shift scores labeled clearly; decision scores are not calibrated probabilities.
statistics: For each capture and comparator, average four conditions within each seed; paired Student t95 interval across five seed differences, df4. Report per-condition differences descriptively. Seeds are algorithmic repetitions, not independent traffic populations. No pooling flows as independent CI units.
success: Preserve D4 criteria: package BA gain>=2pp over frozen, source BA loss<=2pp, FPR<=2 percent; gate BA gain>=1pp versus verified-only and positive mean on both new captures, FPRgap<=1pp/sourcegap>=-2pp. To claim consistent additional gate benefit require lower paired CI>0 on both new captures and report its comparison against simple_max and ARF. Do not claim superiority if either comparator wins. Also report 0.1,0.5,1,2 percent FPR budgets descriptively without choosing a new operating threshold from target gold.
safety_checks: Learners receive no unqueried gold; audit labels never train; correction replay cannot change past predictions; same request/event hashes across packages; predictions and metrics finite; source/target disjoint fingerprint audit; D4 lock files preserved. Test adapter determinism, label availability and audit exclusion before confirmation scoring.
reporting: Publish every capture/scenario/seed result and any implementation amendment, including negative findings. No retuning/replacement on these new results. Re-evaluate paper claims rather than promising improved accuracy or acceptance. Update English five-page manuscript with verified evidence; deliver full supplement and editable source to existing Drive folder. No conference submission.
